regions.today: A mix of sunny spells and scattered showers, some heavy with isolated thunderstorms. Light to moderate west to northwest breeze.
regions.tonight: It will become wet tonight as rain spreads across the region from the southwest. The rain will be heavy at times and may cause localised flooding. Isolated thunderstorms are possible too. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 15 degrees with light and variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow morning will be cloudy and wet with widespread rain, heavy at times. The rain will gradually clear from most areas through the afternoon, with some brighter spells developing, but cloud and light rain will linger in parts of the east until evening. Highest temperatures of 15 to 17 degrees with light to moderate north to northwest winds.
